# Mesh+

> Mesh+ is a free, open-source Android app for Meshtastic radios. Chat in private rooms and encrypted direct messages with no cell service, text through an SMS relay, and update your radio's firmware from your phone.

Connect a Meshtastic radio to your phone and messages hop from radio to radio over long-range LoRa, with no cell towers, Wi-Fi or internet along the way. Mesh+ weighs about 3 MB, needs Android 12 or newer, works with radios on Meshtastic firmware 2.x (such as the Heltec Mesh Node T114 or the RAK4631) and has a built-in demo for people without a radio. It's made by Nikita Kolmogorov.

## What it does

- Public chat, encrypted private rooms and end-to-end encrypted direct messages in one list, with delivery checks and unread badges.
- An SMS relay: when one phone on the mesh has cell service, everyone in a chosen private room can send and receive regular text messages through it.
- Firmware updates for the radio from the phone, pairing over Bluetooth or USB-C, and invites to rooms by QR code or link.

## Get it

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.borodutch.meshplus)
- [APK](https://github.com/backmeupplz/meshtastic-plus/releases/latest/download/meshplus.apk)
